en: Morning, Tenko.
HAIYAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!!
Whoa!

Oh! I'm so sorry about that!
Good morning!
Wh-What was that all about!?

Well, I haven't done much training since I got
here, so I did some light exercise in the gym!

But I'm still full of energy, so I'm shouting
to burn it off!
I see...

Anyway, exercise makes me hungry so I'm
gonna head to the dining hall! See ya!
*sigh*
What's wrong?
Look at this. My nails are all messed up...

It probably happened when we came here.
And now I can't take good care of them.
Your nails?

I understand... You're surprised that plain 
old me cares about my nails, right?
Well, not really...

But when you say nails, you mean nail art,
right? I've never done it before.

Oh, I see. Nails would just plain get in 
the way when playing piano, huh?
Yeah.

I know! I can give you this nail brush if
you want.

Huh? Are you sure? But, I can't just 
take it for free.
Don't worry about it!

No, no. For things like this, we need an
equivalent exchange.
Equivalent exchange?

Oh, I got it! How about I do 
your nails later?
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

No really, it's okay! I'm happy if it's useful
to you!
Really?

Then, I'll definitely use it.
Thank you, Kaede.

Really!?
Yay, please do!

Then let's do it this afternoon...
Oh! We can use the Game Room.
Got it! Thanks a bunch!
Yeah, see you later.

<CLT=cltMIND>Nails, huh? It's gonna be my first time!
I'm so excited!

As a pianist, you're pretty strict 
about stuff like this, I guess.

You're exaggerating. But yeah, sometimes
I gotta hold back on some stuff.

Well, I guess the middle of a killing game 
isn't the time to be worrying about nails...
*sigh* I want to hurry and go home...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us...
But there's nothing displayed right now.
